source_document.note: This is the EXACT url already cited as the load-bearing citation for hardener.ancamide_220x70.ahew (url field), hardener.ancamide_2353.ahew (url field) and hardener.ancamide_260a.ahew (url field) in the live reference/mvp20/data/facts.json -- not a new/untrusted source.
source_document.extraction_method: pdftotext -layout, then row-anchored grep on the AMIDOAMINES product table (Curing Agent / Type / Color / Viscosity / Specific Gravity / Amine Value (mg KOH/g) / WT/{H} Equivalent [=AHEW, g/eq] / Use Level / Gel Time / Thin Film Set Time / Glass Transition Temp / Typical Cure Schedule columns, header confirmed at pdftotext line ~795-853)
source_document.column_order_validation: AHEW (WT/{H} Equivalent) column extracted for ancamide_350a (the in-catalog cross-check row) reads 100 g/eq, byte-identical to reference/mvp20/data/facts.json hardener.ancamide_350a.ahew=100.0 and amine_value=380.0 (row: AV=380, AHEW=100) -- confirms correct column mapping before trusting the 3 target rows below.

target_rows_raw_text.hardener.ancamide_220x70: ANCAMIDE® 220-X-70   Amide Solution   7   1,100   0.940   170   264   709   NA   ambient temp   Ancamide® 220-X-70 is a 70wt% solution of Ancamide® 220 in xylene.
target_rows_raw_text.hardener.ancamide_2353: ANCAMIDE® 2353   Modified Polyamide   9   3,000   1.01   330   114   60   65   4.5   131   ambient temp   Excellent high-gloss film formation and fast dry with no induction time.
target_rows_raw_text.hardener.ancamide_260a: ANCAMIDE® 260A   Amide/ Imidazoline   7   40,000   0.960   350   120   65   120   10   NA   ambient temp   Standard medium-viscosity polyamide. 1:1 volume ratios with standard liquid epoxy resin possible.

hardener.ancamide_220x70.basis_note: Both AV and AHEW are on the same 70wt% xylene-solution basis (facts.json single_source_waiver: 'Evonik product TDS direct read (solution basis)') -- consistent basis for the ratio.

hardener.ancamide_260a.basis_note: facts.json uses the US value (120); EMEA guide reports 110 (pre-existing disclosed regional conflict, not touched by this audit).
